interventions.body: The prognosis is influenced by several documented factors. Favorable findings include negative surgical margins (0.0), no seminal vesicle invasion (0.0), absence of lymphovascular invasion (0.0), and no lymph node metastasis (0.0). The surgical pathology grade was ISUP grade group 2. Countervailing factors include the preoperative PSA of 8.1 and the documented presence of perineural invasion on biopsy. The biopsy finding of Acinar adenocarcinoma was noted, and the surgical pathology grade was consistent with the biopsy grade. Missing postoperative PSA or follow-up data widens the uncertainty regarding the subsequent trajectory. The current heuristic horizon suggests a follow-up period with no event. Information regarding postoperative PSA levels and its subsequent trajectory would be crucial in refining this prognosis. The fixed estimated horizon is 69.39 months.
